title: v2x_adversarial_sensing: honest, reproducible release of the Dual-Stream Phase-Aware Inception-Time CNN for adversarially robust V2X spectrum sensing
description:
Reproducible research artifact for the ICE2CT-2026 paper “Dual-Stream Phase-Aware Inception-Time CNN for Adversarially Robust Spectrum Sensing in V2X Networks” (Dhankhar & Vats).

Includes: the exact 86,052-parameter dual-stream CNN pipeline behind the paper’s Tables II/III/V (synthetic LTE / WiFi / V2X-PC5 / Noise dataset, TF-CutMix training, FGSM / PGD / APGD / FAB / Square attacks); a corrected metrics module reporting robust accuracy and conditional ASR; a one-command CPU reproduction harness; and a full honesty audit (AUDIT.md) that annotates every legacy result file, including one marked INVALID and not citable.
